benefits.text: 10 minutes a day, 3 times a week

paragraphs: Magic by J brings professional grade 3D LED light therapy Silicon Mask into your own home. Designed the same way every treatment at House of Beauty by J begins, around what your skin actually needs.
Soft, lightweight, and completely wireless. Slip it on, choose your light, and give your skin ten quiet minutes. No harsh routines, no downtime, just a glow that builds session after session.

modes.title: Choose the light your skin is asking for.
